Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for AIIMS Jodhpur?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Project Technical support - II (field staff) position at AIIMS Jodhpur is scheduled for 03 September 2026. Candidates must ensure they attend on this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have completed 12th in Science with a Diploma (MLT/DMLT) and five years of relevant experience, or a three-year Graduate degree in a relevant field with two years of experience. An M.Sc in Microbiology with lab experience is also preferred.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Project Technical support - II (field staff) position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for this position is 30 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per government rules.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for this contractual role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 20000 plus 20% HRA per month.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for this AIIMS Jodhpur recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for this recruitment will be based on an interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their performance in the interview.

faq.question: Q7. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: You should carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies of your educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and category certificate (if applicable), along with recent passport-size photographs.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: This is a contractual job opportunity at AIIMS Jodhpur.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the walk-in interview going to be held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at All India Institute of Medical Sciences Jodhpur, Rajasthan.

faq.question: Q10. How many vacancies are available for the Project Technical support - II (field staff) post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Project Technical support - II (field staff) position at AIIMS Jodhpur.
